help.products:
When you enable automatic product synchronization, the products will be automatically synchronized between STEL Order and WooCommerce, according to the field configuration defined in the integration.

This allows you to keep the product information updated and synchronized between both platforms.
help.orders:
When you enable automatic order synchronization, the orders will be automatically synchronized from WooCommerce to STEL Order, according to the order statuses in WooCommerce that you have selected in the integration settings.

This allows you to keep the order information updated in STEL Order.
help.invoices: When you enable automatic invoice synchronization, the invoices will be automatically synchronized from WooCommerce to STEL Order, including both invoices and credit notes, according to the order statuses in WooCommerce that you have selected in the integration settings.

help.stock:
The stock field works differently from the other fields, as its synchronization is only performed in one direction: from STEL Order to WooCommerce.

You can choose between virtual stock or real stock, depending on your integration needs.

Keep in mind that changes made to the stock in WooCommerce will not be synchronized back to STEL Order.

help.selection:
The synchronization with WooCommerce is performed automatically for the products that are already published on both platforms, as well as for the new products that are published.

To define what information of the products is synchronized and in which direction, it is necessary to configure previously the product fields that are desired to be synchronized.
